name: Longer Days Datapack, Day and Night Length
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: MD22
description: Set how long the day and the night last - separately. Long days with normal nights, or any mix, with two numbers. Server-side datapack: no mod, no client install, works on a world you already play.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
